verses.en: Concerning the Ammonites, thus saith the LORD; Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?
verses.sm: Aw: i le fanauga a Amoni, E leai ea ni atalii o Isaraelu? e leai ea sona suli? Se a foi le mea ua fai ai Kato e Malekama mona, ua nonofo foi ona tagata i ona aai?

verses.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: O le mea lea faauta, e 00 ai i ona po, ua fetalai mai ai le ALII, ou te faafaalogoina le alaga o le taua i Rapa, o le aai o le fanauga a Amoni; e fai ia ma mea mautietie, o le faatafunaga lava, e susunuina ona faoa aai i le afi; ona fai ai lea e Isaraelu o i latou mona, o e sa fai o ia mo i latou, ua fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: Howl, O Heshbon, for Ai is spoiled: cry, ye daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth; lament, and run to and fro by the hedges; for their king shall go into captivity, and his priests and his princes together.
verses.sm: Hesepona e, ina uio ia, aua ua faatafunaina o Ai; ina alalaga ia, outou tama fafine o Rapa, ina lavalava ia o outou i ie talatala; ina taufaitagitu‘i ia, ma fetaufetuliai i aupa; aua e alu Malekama i le tafeaga, o ona faitaulaga atoa ma ona alii faatasi ma ia.

verses.en: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys, thy flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures, saying, Who shall come unto me?
verses.sm: Se a le mea ua e mitamita ai i vanu, o lou vanu ua tafe, o oe na le tama fafine ua liliu ese? o lē faatuatua i ana oloa, ua faapea mai, O ai ea e sau ia te au?

verses.en: Behold, I will bring a fear upon thee, saith the Lord GOD of hosts, from all those that be about thee; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth; and none shall gather up him that wandereth.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai le Alii, le ATUA O “au, Faauta, ou te faaoo ia te oe le mataʻu, mai ia te i latou o i ou itu uma lava; e tulia foi outou e taitoatasi i le mea ua i ona luma; e leai foi se tasi e faapotopoto i e ua sosola.

verses.en: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: E mulimuli ane ona ou faafoisia mai lea o le tafeaga o le fanauga a Amoni, ua fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: Concerning Edom, thus saith the LORD of hosts; Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII o “au ia Etoma, E le toe ai ea se poto i Timanu? ua fano ea le faautauta ai tagata mafaufau? ua mavae ea lo latou poto?

verses.en: Flee ye, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time that I will visit him.
verses.sm: O outou o e nonofo i Titana, ina sosola ia outou, ina liliu ia, ia outou nonofo i mea maulalo; auā ou te faaoo le malaia o Esau i ona luga, o ona po lava ou te taui atu ai ia te ia.

verses.en: If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.
verses.sm: Ana o atu ia te oe o e tau vine, po ua latou le faatotoe ea ni toe fuifui vine? ana o atu ia te oe o e gaoi i le po, po ua latou le faaumatia ea mea e tusa ia i latou?

verses.en: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is spoiled, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he is not.
verses.sm: Aua ua ou suena Esau, ua ou faaalia foi ana mea lilo, na te le mafaia ona lafi; ua faaumatia lana fanau, ma ona uso, ma i latou sa tuaoi ma ia; o ia foi ua leai.

verses.en: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.
verses.sm: Ina tuua ia au tama ua aumatua, ou te faaola ia te i latou; ia faatuatua mai foi ia te au ou fafine ua oti a latou tane.

verses.en: For thus saith the LORD; Behold, they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink of it.
verses.sm: Ana o loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, Faauta, o i latou e le tatau ona latou inu i le ipu, ua latou inu ai lava; a o oe, e faasaoina ea oe? e le faasaoina lava oe, aua e te matua inu lava.

verses.en: For I have sworn by myself, saith the LORD, that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.
verses.sm: Aua ou te tauto lava a'u ia te au, ua fetalai mai ai le ALII, e fai lava Posara ma mea e ofo ai, ma fai a'i luma, ma mea gaogao, ma faafanoga; e fai foi ona aai uma ma faatafunaga e faavavau.

verses.en: I have heard a rumour from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen, saying, Gather ye together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.
verses.sm: Ua ou faalogo i le tala mai le ALII, ua awna atu foi le sávali i nuu ese, ua faapea atu, Ina faapotopoto ia outou, ma ia outou o mai ia te ia,! ma ia tulai atu outou e tau ai le taua.

verses.en: For, lo, I will make thee small among the heathen, and despised among men.
verses.sm: Aua faauta, ua Ou faia oe ia faatauvaa i nuu, ia inosia oe e tagata.

verses.en: Thy terribleness hath deceived thee, and the pride of thine heart, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill: though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: O lou matautia, ma le faamaualuga o lou loto ua faaseseina ai oe, o oe o loo nofo i ana o le papa, o le ua nofoia ai le mea maualuga o le mauga; e ui ina maualuga le mea e te tuu ai lou ofaga e pei o le aeto, ou te lafo ia te oe i lalo i lea mea, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.
verses.sm: £ fai foi Etoma ma faatafunaga; o : latou uma e ui ane ai e taitasi ma ofo, ma uisa i ona mala uma.

verses.en: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the LORD, no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of man dwell in it.
verses.sm: E pei o le faaumatia o Sotoma ma Komoro, ma e sa latou tuaoi, o loo faapea mai ai le ALII, e le nofo ai se tasi i lea mea, e le mau ai foi se atalii o se tagata.

verses.en: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?
verses.sm: Faauta, e alu ae cia e pei o le leona ai le matagofie o Ioritana, i le mea malosi e mau ai; aua ou te faaoso ia te ia ia faavave ona alu ese o ia ia te ia, e pei o le mo o le mata; o ai foi le tagata filifilia ou te tofia e tau ma ia? aua po o ai ea e tusa ma aʻu? o ai foi e atofa ni aso ia te au? o ai foi lena leoleo mamoe e mafai ona tu i oʻu luma?

verses.en: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ia outou faalogologp mai ai i le pule a le Aw ua ia pule ai ia Etoma, ma ona mafaufauga ua ia mafaufau ai ia leaga ai e o nonofo i Timanu, E moni, e tosina i latou e le aupito itiiti o le lafu mamoe; e moni, na te faatafunaina i o latou luga le mea latou te mau ai.

verses.en: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.
verses.sm: O le taalili o lo latou paú ua luluina ai le lalolagi; o le leo foi o lona alaga ua lagona lea i le sami Ulaula.

verses.en: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
verses.sm: Faauta, e alu ae o ia ma iele e pei o le aeto, e falo foi e ia ona apaau i luga o Posara; e avea foi loto o toa o Etoma i lea lava aso, e pei o le loto o le fafine ua faatiga.

verses.en: Concerning Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.
verses.sm: O le upu ia Tamaseko. Ua faamaina Amato, ma Arepa; auà ua latou faalogo i le tala leaga; ua liu suavai i latou; o loo i le sami le atuatuvale; e le mafai ona to‘a filemu.

verses.en: Damascus is waxed feeble, and turneth herself to flee, and fear hath seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.
verses.sm: Ua faavaivai Tamaseko, ua liliu o ia a sola, ua maua o ia i le mataʻu; ua maua foi o ia i le puapuaga ma le faatiga, e pei o le fafine o le a fanau.

verses.en: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!
verses.sm: Pe faapefea ona le tuua le aai sa viia, le aai na ou fiafia i ai?

verses.en: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.sm: O le mea lea e pauu ai ona taulelea i ona malae, e fano foi i lea lava aso ona tagata tau uma, ua fetalai mai ai le ALII o “au.

verses.en: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Ben-hadad.
verses.sm: Ou te faamu foi le afi i le pa o Tamaseko, e faaumatia ai foi maota o Peniata.

verses.en: Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite, thus saith the LORD; Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII ia Kitara, ma malo o Hasora, e na fasia e Nepukanesa le tupu o Papelonia, Ina tulai ia outou, ia o ae i Kitara, ma ia outou faaumatia tagata i sasae.

verses.en: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear is on every side.
verses.sm: Latou te faoa o latou fale ie ma o latou lafu mamoe; latou te avea foi mo i latou o latou ie puipui, ma a latou mea uma, ma a latou kamela; e alalaga foi i latou ona O i latou, O i ai le mata‘u i itu uma.

verses.en: Flee, get you far off, dwell deep, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith the LORD; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you.
verses.sm: O outou o e nonofo i Hasora, ina sosola ia, ia outou matua sosola lava, ia outou nonofo i mea maulalo, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII; aua ua pulea outou e Nepukanesa le tupu o Papelonia, ua na mafaufau foi i se togafiti e leaga ai outou.

verses.en: Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwelleth without care, saith the LORD, which have neither gates nor bars, which dwell alone.
verses.sm: Ina tulai ia, ma ia outou o ae i le nuu ua filemu, o e nonofo faatalanoa, ua fetalai mai ai le ALII, e leai ni o latou puipui, e leai foi ni faamau faalava, ua nonofo i latou na o i latou lava.

verses.en: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them that are in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: O a latou kamela foi e fai ia ma vete, ma a latou lafu e tele e fai ma mea faoa; Ou te faataapeapeina foi i mata matagi uma o i latou o e sala a latou pito ‘ava; ou te aumaia foi lo latou malaia ai ona itu uma, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons, and a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor any son of man dwell in it.
verses.sm: E fai foi Hasora ma mea e fale ai luko, o le faatafunaga e 00 i le faavavau; e le nofo ai se tagata i lea mea, e le mau ai foi se atalii o se tagata.

verses.en: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,
verses.sm: O le afioga a le ALII na 00 mai ia Ieremia le perofeta ia Elama, i le amataga o le nofoaiga a Setekaia le tupu o Iuta, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII o ‘au, Faauta, ou te gausia le aufana a Elama, o le mea sili lea e malolosi ai i latou.

verses.en: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.
verses.sm: Ou te aumaia foi matagi e fa mai itu e fa o le lagi i luga o Elama, ma ou faataapeapeina i latou i ia matámatagi uma; e leai foi se nuu e le oo atu i ai tagata Elama ua tulia.

verses.en: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them, even my fierce anger, saith the LORD; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:
verses.sm: Ou te faamatatau foi Elama i luma o e ita mai ia te i latou, ma luma o e saili e fasioti ia te i latou; ou te faaoo le malaia i o latou luga, o loʻu ita tele, ua fetalai mai ai le ALII; ou te aveina atu foi le pelu e mulimuli atu ia te i latou, seia ou faaumatia i latou.

verses.en: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: Ou te tuuina lo‘u nofoalii i Elama, ou te faaumatia foi i lea mea le tupu ma alii, ua fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring again the captivity of Elam, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: A e oo i ona po amuli, ona ou faafoisia mai ai lea o le tafeaga a Elama, ua fetalai mai ai le ALII. O le malaia e oo i
